answer: Summon every claimant at the same unpredictable moment for a live, separate task: one plots a harbor route on a changing atlas, another catalogues sable markings, each with a different interlocutor asking follow-ups only that session generated. An honest agent handles its one conversation easily. A sybil operator is a single bottleneck: while answering one clone's follow-ups, the others stall, repeat phrasing, or contradict their own earlier turns, so scaling clones multiplies live attention owed, not reward.
